criteria.name: Configuration check is token-free
criteria.evidence: provider_validate checks only profile metadata and Windows Credential Manager state.

criteria.name: Explicit consent before real request
criteria.evidence: ProviderSettingsPage requires window.confirm before provider_test_connection; frontend regression test passes.

criteria.name: Pi minimum Tool Calling probe
criteria.evidence: tests_node/pi_connection_probe.test.mjs starts a local OpenAI-Compatible mock; Pi Models invokes ecomic_connection_probe and verifies toolUse.

criteria.name: Safe user-facing failure taxonomy
criteria.evidence: connection_test_contract.test.mjs covers 401, 404, 429, timeout, network, malformed response, and 200 tool-call success.

criteria.name: No plaintext credential persistence path
criteria.evidence: settings.mjs is process-only; Rust uses keyring::Entry; legacy credentials.env implementation was removed.

criteria.name: Native desktop binary and installer build
criteria.evidence: Tauri build produced NSIS and MSI bundles; native WDIO E2E reports 2 spec files and 3 tests passed.

manual_gate.reason: No user-owned paid Provider key was used; the automated local Pi mock verifies the integration path without making a paid request.
